relations.text: AdvantageとAdvantage2のLeapサービスは、AWS Marketplace経由でも購入できる

source.quote: Advantage TM and Advantage2 systems are available via our Leap service, and access to the Leap service and other services can be purchased directly from D-Wave or through Amazon Web Services (“ AWS ”) Marketplace.

relations.text: 2011年にLockheed Martinとの共同研究を発表した
relations.text_en: Announced a collaboration with Lockheed Martin in 2011

source.label: D-Wave Quantum 10-K
source.quote: By 2011, we officially moved our research and development into a new phase when we announced our collaboration with Lockheed Martin, allowing for outside scientists and engineers to work with our quantum systems and to provide critical feedback on our continuing quantum system development.
